payload.headline: Prototyped a Lakebase-backed feature store to replace self-managed Postgres ahead of a Q3 Snowflake renewal.
payload.what_they_built: Stood up a synced table from a streaming pipeline into Lakebase and a small Databricks App that reads per-account features by key, then benchmarked lookup latency against their current EC2 Postgres. Ended the session with a working read path and a Genie space over the same tables for their analysts.

use_cases.title: Lakebase as the online feature store for fraud scoring
use_cases.summary: Replace a self-managed EC2 Postgres with Lakebase, kept current by synced tables from the authorisation stream rather than a nightly dbt refresh.
use_cases.evidence: attendee prompt about sub-100ms feature lookups; promote/architecture.md

use_cases.title: Analyst self-service over the same feature tables
use_cases.summary: A Genie space over the feature tables so fraud analysts stop raising tickets for one-off lookups.

blockers: SASL authentication against their broker config failed from the workshop workspace.
Unclear whether synced-table latency meets their sub-100ms scoring budget.
Snowflake egress cost is the stated driver, and they have no current benchmark to compare against.

artifacts.title: Add per-account feature lookup by key
